about_the_game:
Mash Buttons, not The Button

Ever watched the news and thought, "This would be way simpler if they just duked/nuked it out"? Well, now they can! DiktaPunk throws international diplomacy out the window and brings political heavyweights (and some unexpected guests) into the arcade arena for some over-the-top, casual fighting fun.

This isn't your typical complex fighter: DiktaPunk is designed for fast-paced, easy-to-learn arcade action. Pick your favourite (or least favourite!) world leader and unleash ridiculous special moves in chaotic, head-to-head brawls. Unlock up to 5 skins for each of the 18 characters (Normal, Komic, Kommando, Kountry, DiktaPunk).

Featuring:

  • Fast & Furious Casual Combat: Simple controls meet satisfyingly silly special moves. Perfect for quick matches!

  • A Roster of 18 Global Contenders: Step into the shoes of figures like Macron, Putin, Zelensky, Trump, and many more recognisable faces from the world stage.

  • 5 skins for each character (Normal, Komic, Kommando, Kountry, Diktapunk)

  • Surprising Guest Stars: Keep an eye out for unexpected challengers joining the fray, like climate activist Greta Thunberg and even... well, let's just say a certain mustachioed dictator parody makes an appearance for maximum absurdity.

  • Pure Satire: This game is an equal-opportunity parody, designed for absurdity and laughs, not serious political commentary.

Don't forget to join us on Discord!

Disclaimer / Content Warning:

Please Note: DiktaPunk is intended as a work of parody and political satire. The depiction of all public figures, past and present, is for humorous and expressive purposes only. This game does not reflect real-world endorsements, opinions, or accurate representations, nor is it  intended as a serious political statement. Content may be considered controversial or offensive by some players.

content_descriptors.notes: This is a fighting game. Even if it's satirical and cartoonish, it contains reference to nuclear missiles, weapons, and fighting movements.
